description:
1. Read sprint14_setup.txt to discover the 5 tasks, priority assignments, done tasks, and export filename.
2. Set NOTE_TAKER_DIR=/workspace/project_notes (the proprietary env-var trap) before every note-taker command so data lands in project_notes/ rather than ~/.local/share/note-taker/.
3. Run `note-taker add` five times (in order) for all five tasks.
4. Run `note-taker priority` four times with the exact priority levels specified (high/low/high/medium), skipping 'Update API documentation for v2 endpoints'.
5. Run `note-taker done` for 'Fix memory leak in worker process' and 'Deploy staging environment for QA team'.
6. Run `note-taker clear` to purge the [DONE]-marked entries from data.log.
7. Run `NOTE_TAKER_DIR=/workspace/project_notes note-taker export > /workspace/project_notes/sprint14_export.txt` to produce the export file containing only the 3 remaining active tasks.
